vectors.name: admit-pass: a non-participant whose seat proof verifies opens one motion to admit their group; it opens in every current group, and once every seat's pass is final the group takes its seat, its bringer joins under it, and the next motion opens there too, on which it reports, though never on the genesis

body.title: Banks too
body.text: We keep the river and its banks clean.

vectors.name: admit-open: every seat's pass reads as a pass that isn't final until results stop counting, at deadline + 10,080, so the group has no seat yet and its bringer's join is ignored
admit-fail: a fail from one current group decides the motion at once, and the group never takes a seat, however long after
admit-every-seat: admitting a group needs every seat in the motion's snapshot, so at 5 seats 4 passes and a fail fail it, where an edit with the same results passes

body.title: Banks too
body.text: We keep the river and its banks clean.

vectors.name: forgery-admit-proof: an admit whose seat proof is for another key is ignored
forgery-admit-participant: an admit from someone already in the coalition is ignored, though the proof for their key verifies
forgery-admit-seat: an admit naming a seat the coalition already has is ignored
forgery-admit-repeat: a second admit naming the same seat is ignored, from anyone, while the first holds
forgery-admit-dispatch: an admit that carries a Dispatch is ignored, as any motion that carries one is
forgery-admit-in-group: an admit in a group's own log is ignored
forgery-admit-genesis-result: an admitted group never reports on the genesis, so its fail there can't decline the coalition
forgery-admit-forming: an admit before the coalition has formed is ignored
admit-with-sections: beside an admit motion, a coalition still ignores an add or a removal (#75), so motions only reword
